note: Field checks for a Register of Information export (DORA, Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 28(3)). Every check is computed from the file itself - format, arithmetic and cross-row consistency. No check gives legal advice.

provider_lei.label: LEI of the ICT third-party provider

provider_name.label: Name of the ICT third-party provider

critical.label: Supports a critical or important function

country.label: Country of provision of the service

rules.title: Required column absent
rules.msg: The header has no column for "{label}". Every row is therefore unchecked for it.

rules.title: Semicolon-separated file
rules.msg: This file is semicolon-separated (a regional Excel export). Parsed with ';' - re-export as comma-separated UTF-8 before you upload it.

rules.title: Broken UTF-8
rules.msg: "{value}" looks like UTF-8 read as Latin-1. Provider names with accents will reach the supervisor mangled.

rules.title: Row width differs from header
rules.msg: This row has {got} fields, the header has {want}. An unescaped comma or quote has shifted every value after it.

rules.title: Required cell empty
rules.msg: "{label}" is empty on this row.

rules.title: LEI is not 20 characters
rules.msg: "{label}" is "{value}" - {got} characters. An LEI (ISO 17442) is exactly 20.

rules.title: LEI has illegal characters
rules.msg: "{label}" is "{value}" - an LEI is upper-case A-Z and 0-9 only.

rules.title: LEI check digits fail
rules.msg: "{label}" is "{value}" - the last two digits should be {want}, not {got} (ISO 7064 MOD 97-10). One character is wrong or transposed.

rules.title: LEI is a placeholder
rules.msg: "{label}" is "{value}" - a placeholder, not an identifier.

rules.title: One LEI, two names
rules.msg: LEI {value} is filed as "{got}" here and "{want}" on line {other}. The supervisor keys on the LEI; pick one legal name.

rules.title: Contract reference used twice
rules.msg: Contractual arrangement reference "{value}" is already used on line {other}. References must be unique across the register.

rules.title: Identical row
rules.msg: This row repeats line {other} field for field.

rules.title: Linked arrangement not in the file
rules.msg: This row points at overarching arrangement "{value}", which no row in this file declares. The link will not resolve.

rules.title: Row links to itself
rules.msg: This row names itself ("{value}") as its own overarching arrangement.

rules.title: Date is not ISO 8601
rules.msg: "{label}" is "{value}". Write dates as yyyy-mm-dd - {got} is read the other way round outside your locale.

rules.title: Date does not exist
rules.msg: "{label}" is "{value}" - there is no such day in the calendar.

rules.title: Contract ends before it starts
rules.msg: End date {got} is earlier than start date {want}.

rules.title: Arrangement already ended
rules.msg: This arrangement ended on {value}, before the reference date {want}. A terminated contract still listed as live is a finding the reviewer raises, not you.

rules.title: Country is not a 2-letter code
rules.msg: "{label}" is "{value}". This field takes an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (two upper-case letters), not a country name.

rules.title: Unrecognised country code
rules.msg: "{value}" is not in this extension's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 list. Check it before you file.

rules.title: Currency is not a 3-letter code
rules.msg: "{label}" is "{value}". This field takes an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code, not a symbol or a name.

rules.title: Unrecognised currency code
rules.msg: "{value}" is not in this extension's ISO 4217 list. Check it before you file.

rules.title: Yes/no field is neither
rules.msg: "{label}" is "{value}". This field is yes or no - a free-text answer cannot be aggregated.

rules.title: Amount is not a plain number
rules.msg: "{label}" is "{value}". Report the amount as digits with an optional decimal point ({want}) - thousands separators and symbols break the load.
